evals.js: moire.matter.chem.kUpSwap = 0.3; return 'uphill swaps x15'

const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.3, v.cssH * 0.35, 'soap', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.3, v.cssH * 0.65, 'oil', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.7, v.cssH * 0.65, 'emulsion', 120); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.5, v.cssH * 0.5, 'linker', 120); return moire.matter.springs.length
await moire.genome.setAll({ wall: 0.8, wallRow: 0.5, oilShare: 0.5 }, { cells: Array.from({ length: 2000 }, (_, k) => 4 * k) }); return 'a quarter of the slots walled and oily'
return moire.control.action('culture')
return moire.control.action('wash')
const v = moire.control.view(); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.4, v.cssH * 0.4, 'soap', 200); moire.matter.addSpring(v.cssW * 0.6, v.cssH * 0.6, 'linker', 200); return 1
return moire.control.action('genomes')
